name: session-coordination
description: Per-session CLI and sidecar control paths that declare work to Concordia, apply provider launch settings, seed detached workspace trust only for a registered Concordia enrollment, and keep optional observability outside the control dependency chain.
cardTemplate: Summarise the session-coordination domain: task declaration remains available independently of optional observability artifacts.
specRefs: タスク宣言プロトコル
セットアップ — 観測 (Vestigium) は best-effort
rationale: Session coordination owns task declaration and provider launch settings. Persistent workspace trust is limited to non-interactive sessions with a registered Concordia enrollment; ordinary interactive sessions retain provider confirmation UI. The executable boundary must refuse stale root build artifacts, while optional observability remains outside the control dependency chain.
